# Copilot Instructions

Follow [docs/AI_ENGINEERING.md](../docs/AI_ENGINEERING.md).

Kollegan is an ERP platform. Demos are isolated and must not drive ERP domain naming or architecture.

Do not suggest destructive migrations, direct Prisma usage in UI/routes, browser imports from services/repositories, hardcoded UI colors, or new monolithic files. Prefer existing DDD module patterns, shared UI primitives, semantic CSS variables, API clients, and additive schema changes.
